key.name: eye-enabled
key.description: Indicates whether eyes are displayed on the panel.

key.name: eye-count
key.description: Specifies how many eye instances are displayed on the panel.

key.name: eye-reactive
key.description: Indicates whether the eyes respond to clicks to open the menu.

key.name: eye-refresh-rate
key.description: Specifies the refresh rate of the eyes in frames per second.

key.name: eye-blink-interval
key.description: Specifies a fixed time in seconds between regular blinks.

key.name: eye-blink-interval-range
key.description: Specifies a range of intervals in seconds between random blinks.

key.name: tracker-shape
key.description: Specifies the filename of the image used as the tracker shape.

key.name: tracker-size
key.description: Specifies the size of the tracker element in pixels.

key.name: tracker-color-main-enabled
key.summary: Custom color state of the tracker
key.description: Indicates whether the tracker uses the custom color instead of the theme color.

key.name: tracker-color-main
key.description: Specifies the default color of the tracker.

key.name: tracker-color-left
key.description: Specifies the color of the tracker when a left-click is detected.

key.name: tracker-color-middle
key.description: Specifies the color of the tracker when a middle-click is detected.

key.name: tracker-color-right
key.description: Specifies the color of the tracker when a right-click is detected.

key.name: tracker-opacity
key.description: Specifies the opacity of the tracker from 0 (transparent) to 100 (opaque).

key.name: tracker-refresh-rate
key.description: Specifies the refresh rate of the tracker in frames per second.

key.name: tracker-keybinding
key.description: Specifies the keyboard shortcut that toggles the tracker visibility.

key.name: last-notified-version
key.summary: Last version to trigger a notification
key.description: Specifies the extension version for which the release notification was last shown.
